```{r}
dgi <- read.csv('New Data/New Drug Gene Interactions csv.csv',row.names = 1)
drug_se <- read.csv('New Data/Drug and Side Effects csv.csv')
drug_cf <- read.csv('New Data/Chemical Fingerprint New Drugs csv.csv', row.names = 1)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(pheatmap)
library(igraph)
library(ggraph)
library(UpSetR)
library(vegan)      # rarefaction
library(patchwork)

# ── 1a. Side-effect co-occurrence heatmap (top 30 SEs) ──────────────────────
top_se <- drug_se %>%
  count(side_effect_name, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 30) %>%
  pull(side_effect_name)

se_mat <- drug_se %>%
  filter(side_effect_name %in% top_se) %>%
  select(drugbank_name, side_effect_name) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(present = 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = side_effect_name, values_from = present, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("drugbank_name") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Co-occurrence = how often two SEs appear together across drugs
cooc <- t(se_mat) %*% se_mat
diag(cooc) <- 0  # remove self-pairs

pheatmap(cooc,
         color = colorRampPalette(c("#f7fbff","#c6dbef","#6baed6","#08519c"))(100),
         main = "Side-Effect Co-occurrence (top 30)",
         fontsize = 7,
         border_color = NA,
         treeheight_row = 20, treeheight_col = 20)


# ── 1b. UpSet plot — top SE combinations ────────────────────────────────────
# Show which drugs share combinations of the top 8 most common SEs
top8_se <- drug_se %>%
  count(side_effect_name, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 8) %>%
  pull(side_effect_name)

upset_input <- drug_se %>%
  filter(side_effect_name %in% top8_se) %>%
  select(drugbank_name, side_effect_name) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(present = 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = side_effect_name, values_from = present, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("drugbank_name") %>%
  as.data.frame()

upset(upset_input,
      sets = top8_se,
      order.by = "freq",
      nsets = 8,
      mainbar.y.label = "Drug Count",
      sets.x.label = "Drugs with SE",
      text.scale = 1.2)


# ── 1c. Rarefaction curve — how many unique SEs are "discovered" per drug ──
# Treats each drug as a sampling unit; SEs as species
se_wide <- drug_se %>%
  select(drugbank_name, side_effect_name) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(n = 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = side_effect_name, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("drugbank_name")

rarecurve(se_wide, step = 5, xlab = "Number of Drugs Sampled",
          ylab = "Unique Side Effects", main = "SE Discovery Rarefaction Curve",
          col = "#3182bd", lwd = 1.2, label = FALSE)


# ── 1d. Drug–SE bipartite network (top 20 drugs by burden) ──────────────────
top20_drugs <- drug_se %>%
  count(drugbank_name, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20) %>%
  pull(drugbank_name)

top10_se_for_net <- drug_se %>%
  filter(drugbank_name %in% top20_drugs) %>%
  count(side_effect_name, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 15) %>%
  pull(side_effect_name)

edges_bipartite <- drug_se %>%
  filter(drugbank_name %in% top20_drugs, side_effect_name %in% top10_se_for_net) %>%
  select(from = drugbank_name, to = side_effect_name) %>%
  distinct()

g_bip <- graph_from_data_frame(edges_bipartite, directed = FALSE)
V(g_bip)$type <- V(g_bip)$name %in% top20_drugs  # TRUE = drug, FALSE = SE

ggraph(g_bip, layout = "bipartite") +
  geom_edge_link(alpha = 0.25, color = "grey60") +
  geom_node_point(aes(color = type, size = type)) +
  geom_node_text(aes(label = name, color = type), size = 2.5, repel = TRUE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#440154FF", `FALSE` = "#31688EFF"),
                     labels = c("Side Effect", "Drug")) +
  scale_size_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 4, `FALSE` = 2.5), guide = "none") +
  labs(title = "Drug–Side Effect Bipartite Network",
       subtitle = "Top 20 drugs × top 15 side effects",
       color = NULL) +
  theme_graph(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")


# ── 1e. Side-effect prevalence CDF ─────────────────────────────────────────
se_drug_counts <- drug_se %>%
  count(side_effect_name, sort = TRUE)

ggplot(se_drug_counts, aes(x = n)) +
  stat_ecdf(geom = "step", color = "#3182bd", linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(title = "CDF of Side-Effect Prevalence",
       subtitle = "x-axis: number of drugs reporting each SE (log scale)",
       x = "Number of Drugs", y = "Cumulative proportion of side effects") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# ── 2a. Distribution of genes per drug and drugs per gene ───────────────────
genes_per_drug <- dgi %>%
  rownames_to_column("drug") %>%
  pivot_longer(-drug, names_to = "gene", values_to = "val") %>%
  filter(val != 0) %>%
  count(drug, name = "n_genes")

drugs_per_gene <- dgi %>%
  rownames_to_column("drug") %>%
  pivot_longer(-drug, names_to = "gene", values_to = "val") %>%
  filter(val != 0) %>%
  count(gene, name = "n_drugs")

p1 <- ggplot(genes_per_drug, aes(x = n_genes)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "#1D9E75", color = "white") +
  labs(title = "Genes per Drug", x = "# Genes", y = "# Drugs") +
  theme_minimal()

p2 <- ggplot(drugs_per_gene, aes(x = n_drugs)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "#0F6E56", color = "white") +
  labs(title = "Drugs per Gene", x = "# Drugs", y = "# Genes") +
  theme_minimal()

p1 + p2 + plot_annotation(title = "Drug-Gene Interaction Degree Distributions")


# ── 2b. Top 20 hub genes (most drugs) ───────────────────────────────────────
top_genes <- drugs_per_gene %>%
  slice_max(n_drugs, n = 20)

ggplot(top_genes, aes(x = reorder(gene, n_drugs), y = n_drugs)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#085041") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Top 20 Hub Genes",
       subtitle = "Genes interacting with the most drugs",
       x = "Gene", y = "Number of Drugs") +
  theme_minimal()


# ── 2c. Drug–gene interaction network (top hub genes) ───────────────────────
top15_genes <- top_genes %>% slice_head(n = 15) %>% pull(gene)

edges_dgi <- dgi %>%
  rownames_to_column("drug") %>%
  pivot_longer(-drug, names_to = "gene", values_to = "val") %>%
  filter(val != 0, gene %in% top15_genes) %>%
  select(from = drug, to = gene)

g_dgi <- graph_from_data_frame(edges_dgi, directed = FALSE)
V(g_dgi)$node_type <- ifelse(V(g_dgi)$name %in% top15_genes, "Gene", "Drug")

ggraph(g_dgi, layout = "fr") +
  geom_edge_link(alpha = 0.15, color = "grey70") +
  geom_node_point(aes(color = node_type,
                      size = ifelse(node_type == "Gene", degree(g_dgi), 2))) +
  geom_node_text(aes(label = ifelse(node_type == "Gene", name, ""),
                     color = node_type), size = 3, repel = TRUE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Gene" = "#E8593C", "Drug" = "#3B8BD4")) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 8), guide = "none") +
  labs(title = "Drug–Gene Interaction Network",
       subtitle = "Nodes sized by degree; only gene labels shown",
       color = NULL) +
  theme_graph() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")


# ── 2d. Drug similarity by shared genes (Jaccard) ───────────────────────────
gene_mat <- dgi %>% as.matrix()
gene_mat[gene_mat != 0] <- 1  # binarise

gene_intersect <- gene_mat %*% t(gene_mat)
gene_counts    <- rowSums(gene_mat)
gene_union     <- outer(gene_counts, gene_counts, "+") - gene_intersect
gene_jaccard   <- gene_intersect / gene_union
gene_jaccard[is.na(gene_jaccard)] <- 0

pheatmap(gene_jaccard,
         color = colorRampPalette(c("#ffffff","#c7e9c0","#41ab5d","#005a32"))(100),
         main = "Drug Similarity by Shared Genes (Jaccard)",
         show_rownames = nrow(gene_jaccard) < 50,
         show_colnames = nrow(gene_jaccard) < 50,
         fontsize = 6, border_color = NA,
         treeheight_row = 25, treeheight_col = 25)

```

```{r}
library(Rtsne)
library(factoextra)

# ── 3a. Fingerprint bit frequency (how often each bit is active) ─────────────
bit_freq <- colMeans(drug_cf)

tibble(bit = names(bit_freq), freq = bit_freq) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = freq)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "#534AB7", color = "white") +
  labs(title = "Chemical Fingerprint Bit Frequency Distribution",
       subtitle = "Each bar = one bit position; x = fraction of drugs where bit is active",
       x = "Activation frequency", y = "Number of bits") +
  theme_minimal()

# Bits that are always 0 or always 1 carry no information — flag them
zero_var_bits <- names(bit_freq[bit_freq == 0 | bit_freq == 1])
cat("Zero-variance bits (to exclude from modelling):", length(zero_var_bits), "\n")
cf_filtered <- drug_cf[, !colnames(drug_cf) %in% zero_var_bits]


# ── 3b. PCA of chemical space ────────────────────────────────────────────────
pca_res <- prcomp(cf_filtered, center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)

fviz_eig(pca_res, ncp = 20, addlabels = TRUE,
         barfill = "#AFA9EC", barcolor = "white",
         title = "PCA Scree Plot — Chemical Fingerprints")

pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca_res$x[, 1:2]) %>%
  rownames_to_column("drug")

# Colour by number of side effects
pca_df <- pca_df %>%
  left_join(drug_se %>% count(drugbank_name, name = "n_se"),
            by = c("drug" = "drugbank_name"))

ggplot(pca_df, aes(PC1, PC2, color = n_se)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "C", name = "# Side effects") +
  labs(title = "Chemical Space PCA",
       subtitle = "Drugs coloured by number of adverse drug reactions") +
  theme_minimal()


# ── 3c. t-SNE of chemical fingerprints ──────────────────────────────────────
set.seed(42)
tsne_res <- Rtsne(cf_filtered, dims = 2, perplexity = 30,
                  max_iter = 1000, check_duplicates = FALSE)

tsne_df <- as.data.frame(tsne_res$Y) %>%
  setNames(c("tSNE1", "tSNE2")) %>%
  mutate(drug = rownames(cf_filtered)) %>%
  left_join(drug_se %>% count(drugbank_name, name = "n_se"),
            by = c("drug" = "drugbank_name"))

ggplot(tsne_df, aes(tSNE1, tSNE2, color = n_se)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "B", name = "# Side effects") +
  labs(title = "t-SNE of Chemical Fingerprints",
       subtitle = "Coloured by ADR burden") +
  theme_minimal()


# ── 3d. Tanimoto (chemical similarity) heatmap ──────────────────────────────
cf_mat <- as.matrix(cf_filtered)
# Tanimoto = intersection / union for binary vectors
tanm <- tcrossprod(cf_mat)                         # dot product = intersection
bit_sums <- rowSums(cf_mat)
tanm_denom <- outer(bit_sums, bit_sums, "+") - tanm
tanimoto <- tanm / tanm_denom
tanimoto[is.na(tanimoto)] <- 0

pheatmap(tanimoto,
         color = colorRampPalette(c("#fff7fb","#d0d1e6","#74a9cf","#023858"))(100),
         main = "Tanimoto Chemical Similarity Heatmap",
         show_rownames = FALSE, show_colnames = FALSE,
         border_color = NA,
         treeheight_row = 25, treeheight_col = 25)

```

# ── 4c. Mutual information: fingerprint bits vs high-SE burden ───────────────
# Flag drugs with ADR burden above the 75th percentile
se_q75 <- quantile(merged$n_se, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
high_adr <- merged %>% mutate(high_adr = as.integer(n_se >= se_q75)) %>%
            select(drugbank_name, high_adr)

cf_common <- cf_filtered[common_drugs, ]
high_adr_vec <- high_adr %>%
  filter(drugbank_name %in% common_drugs) %>%
  arrange(match(drugbank_name, rownames(cf_common))) %>%
  pull(high_adr)

# Point-biserial correlation between each bit and high-ADR flag
bit_cors <- apply(cf_common, 2, function(bit) {
  cor(bit, high_adr_vec, method = "pearson")
})

top_bits <- sort(abs(bit_cors), decreasing = TRUE)[1:30]

tibble(bit  = names(top_bits),
       corr = bit_cors[names(top_bits)]) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(bit, corr), y = corr,
             fill = corr > 0)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#E8593C", `FALSE` = "#3B8BD4"),
                    labels = c("Negative", "Positive")) +
  labs(title = "Fingerprint Bits Most Correlated with High ADR Burden",
       subtitle = "Top 30 bits by absolute point-biserial correlation",
       x = "Fingerprint bit", y = "Correlation with high-ADR flag",
       fill = "Direction") +

gene_enrichment <- gene_long %>%

```{r}

# Check the actual distribution of max similarities per drug

# Quick look at the similarity distribution

```


```{r}
# ── Auto-select a sensible threshold ────────────────────────────────────────
# Pick the threshold that gives at least 2 drugs but focuses on the most similar
find_threshold <- function(sim_mat, min_drugs = 2, target_drugs = 50) {
  # Try descending thresholds until we get enough drugs
  for (t in seq(95, 10, by = -5)) {
    candidates <- rownames(sim_mat)[
      apply(sim_mat, 1, function(x) any(x >= t & x < 100))
    ]
    if (length(candidates) >= min_drugs) {
      cat("Auto-selected threshold:", t, "% →", length(candidates), "drugs retained\n")
      return(list(threshold = t, drugs = candidates))
    }
  }
  stop("Cannot find any threshold that retains >= 2 drugs.")
}

auto <- find_threshold(similarity_matrix)
threshold   <- auto$threshold
keep_drugs  <- auto$drugs


```

```{r}
# ── Safe pheatmap with guard ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
threshold <- 10
focused_matrix <- similarity_matrix[keep_drugs, keep_drugs]

# Hard stop with a clear message instead of a cryptic hclust error
if (nrow(focused_matrix) < 2) {
  stop(paste0(
    "Only ", nrow(focused_matrix), " drug(s) passed the threshold of ", threshold, "%. ",
    "Lower the threshold or check that similarity_matrix has non-trivial off-diagonal values."
  ))
}

colors     <- colorRampPalette(c("#ffffff","#deebf7","#9ecae1","#3182bd","#08519c"))(100)
breaks_list <- seq(0, 100, length.out = 101)

# Only cluster rows/cols if there are enough drugs
do_cluster <- nrow(focused_matrix) >= 3

pheatmap(focused_matrix,
         cluster_rows    = do_cluster,
         cluster_cols    = do_cluster,
         treeheight_row  = ifelse(do_cluster, 30, 0),
         treeheight_col  = ifelse(do_cluster, 30, 0),
         show_rownames   = TRUE,
         show_colnames   = TRUE,
         fontsize_row    = max(4, min(10, 80 / nrow(focused_matrix))),  # auto font size
         fontsize_col    = max(4, min(10, 80 / nrow(focused_matrix))),
         cellwidth       = 7,
         cellheight      = 7,
         angle_col       = 45,
         color           = colors,
         breaks          = breaks_list,
         main            = paste("Clustered Drug Similarity (Threshold >=", threshold, "%)"),
         border_color    = NA,
         legend_breaks   = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100),
         legend_labels   = c("0%", "25%", "50%", "75%", "100% Shared"))

```

```{r}
binary_df <- drug_se %>%
  select(drugbank_name, side_effect_name) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(present = 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = side_effect_name, values_from = present, values_fill = 0)

# Convert to Matrix
mat <- as.matrix(binary_df[,-1])
rownames(mat) <- binary_df$drugbank_name

# Calculate Intersection and Union for all drugs
intersection_matrix <- mat %*% t(mat)
side_effect_counts <- diag(intersection_matrix)
sum_matrix <- outer(side_effect_counts, side_effect_counts, "+")
union_matrix <- sum_matrix - intersection_matrix

# Calculate % Similarity (Jaccard Index)
similarity_matrix <- (intersection_matrix / union_matrix) * 100
similarity_matrix[is.na(similarity_matrix)] <- 0

threshold <- 70
keep_drugs <- rownames(similarity_matrix)[apply(similarity_matrix, 1, function(x) any(x >= threshold & x < 100))]

# Subset the matrix to only these drugs
focused_matrix <- similarity_matrix[keep_drugs, keep_drugs]

colors <- colorRampPalette(c("#ffffff", "#deebf7", "#9ecae1", "#3182bd", "#08519c"))(100)
breaks_list <- seq(0, 100, length.out = 101)

pheatmap(focused_matrix,
         # Clustering
         cluster_rows = TRUE,
         cluster_cols = TRUE,
         treeheight_row = 30,
         treeheight_col = 30,
         show_rownames = TRUE,      
         show_colnames = TRUE,      
         fontsize_row = 6,          
         fontsize_col = 6,          
         cellwidth = 7,             
         cellheight = 7,
         angle_col = 45,            
         color = colors,
         breaks = breaks_list,      
         main = paste("Clustered Drug Similarity (Threshold >=", threshold, "%)"),
         border_color = NA,         
         legend_breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100),
         legend_labels = c("0%", "25%", "50%", "75%", "100% Shared"))
```

```{r}

# Top 15 drugs with most side effects
top_drugs <- drug_se %>%
  count(drugbank_name, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 15)

plot_drugs <- ggplot(top_drugs, aes(x = reorder(drugbank_name, n), y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#440154FF") +  # dark purple
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Top Drugs with Highest Side Effects",
    subtitle = "Drugs associated with the greatest number of unique ADRs",
    x = "Drug Name", 
    y = "Number of Side Effects"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10)
  )

# Top 15 most frequent side effects
top_side_effects <- drug_se %>%
  count(side_effect_name, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 15)

plot_side_effects <- ggplot(top_side_effects, aes(x = reorder(side_effect_name, n), y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#31688EFF") +  # steel blue
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Top Most Frequent Side Effects",
    subtitle = "Most pervasive clinical symptoms across dataset",
    x = "Side Effect", 
    y = "Frequency (Number of Drugs)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10)
  )

# Combining the plots side by side
combined_plot <- plot_drugs + plot_side_effects + 
  plot_layout(ncol = 2) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "ADR Dataset Overview",
    subtitle = "Comparison of Top Drugs and Side Effects",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16))
  )
combined_plot
```
